csv_project_name: CMAR for New Cherokee Museum Collection Facility
csv_scope_of_work: The EBCI is requesting statements of qualifications from construction management firms or teams of firms for the purpose of selecting a Construction Manager at Risk (CMR). The CMR will work alongside the design team during the development phase of the project and will be fully responsible for construction of the facilities once a final design is complete. The project is a two and a half story structure containing approximately 35,000 square feet that will house archeological collections, laboratories, conservations labs and other resources to help the Eastern Band of Cherokee to preserve cultural resources.
csv_disciplines_requested: Design Build/Developer, Construction/Project Management, Electrical Engineering, Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering
title: CMAR for New Cherokee Museum Collection Facility
short_description: New 35,000-square-foot museum collection facility with labs and preservation spaces in Cherokee, North Carolina.
project_location: Cherokee, Swain County, North Carolina, USA
project_scope: Construction Manager at Risk procurement for a new approximately 35,000-square-foot, two-and-a-half-story museum collection facility. The building will house archaeological collections, laboratories, conservation labs, and related resources for preservation of cultural assets for the Eastern Band of Cherokee Indians.
services: Construction Manager at Risk services during design development and full construction responsibility after final design completion; requested disciplines include design-build/developer, construction/project management, electrical engineering, fire protection engineering, mechanical engineering, and structural engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Building project with some structural engineering relevance.
- Cultural facility type is generally of interest, but this notice is primarily for CMAR/construction management rather than direct structural design.
- Building size is moderate at about 35,000 square feet and no special long-span or innovative structural features are stated.
- Could offer indirect teaming opportunities, but limited fit for sbp as a lead engineering role.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. Available scope information for estimation: new two-and-a-half-story building of approximately 35,000 square feet for museum collections, laboratories, and conservation labs in Cherokee, North Carolina. A rough order-of-magnitude estimate for such a specialized collection/lab facility could be in the range of 21000000 to 35000000 USD depending on environmental controls, archival requirements, and laboratory fit-out, but this is not confirmed by the tender documents.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided. Because the notice is for CMAR procurement rather than a direct structural engineering contract, an sbp fee cannot be derived reliably from the source.
references_qualifications: Statements of qualifications are requested from construction management firms or teams of firms for selection of a Construction Manager at Risk. No specific minimum reference counts or detailed qualification thresholds are stated in the source.
award_criteria: Not stated in the source; selection is based on statements of qualifications under an RFP/RFQ process.
